Music Club.name: Music Club
Music Club.description:
🎸 You played in the light music club and a garage band.

🎤 You still remember every second of your school festival stage.
🎛️ You know your way around recording gear.

📈 Grants: Performance +5, Media Production +5
Music Club.traitNarrativeEffects: The character played in a band through high school: rehearsals, small gigs and recording sessions. They are comfortable on a stage, keep rhythm with a team and know their way around a mixing desk and a camera.
